title: HOTTER THAN THE HINGES ON THE GATES TO H-E-DOUBLE TOOTHPICKS!!
text:
HOTTER THAN THE HINGES ON THE GATES TO H-E-DOUBLE TOOTHPICKS!!. Okay, I read the reviews about this being a lousy airfryer but decided to ignore them because I wanted a reasonably priced airfyer that would look and work like a toaster oven to leave out on the counter. The reviewers who say this is a lousy airfryer are right. It is lousy. It takes too long, it doesn't brown and crisp food like the spaceship looking airfyers do and I regret with every fiber of my being making this purchase.

That being said, what I didn't see in any of the reviews was anybody addressing the fact that this thing GETS HOTTER THAN THE HINGES TO H-E-DOUBLE TOOTHPICKS ON THE OUTSIDE!!! When you are removing your food there is NO PLACE except the handle that you can touch where it will not give you 3RD DEGREE BURNS. I mean like seriously melt the skin off your hands. Now you may say, well lady, you just said you can touch the handle and it's not hot and you'd be right but the serious design flaw with that is there is there is no hinge on the door so when you open it all the way to use both hands to pull your food out, the handle sits on the kitchen counter under the thousand degree glass door. You can't just prop it open half way and have it stay like that like you would with your oven so you can maintain access to the handle. You either open all the way to use both hands to remove your food or open it half way and hold the handle with one hand while trying to remove your food one handed.

If that doesn't scare you off, wait until your husband makes toast in the morning and 5 minutes later you hear blood curdling shrieks from one of the kids, roommates, significant others or God forbid your own because it was touched by someone who wasn't aware that it had been recently used!! It takes forever to cool down and if you're a busy/absentminded person like myself YOU WILL GET BURNED. I've now instructed everyone in the house to treat this DEVIL like you would if you saw the iron out on the ironing board. You wouldn't just grab the iron, you'd gingerly touch it to see if it was hot. We've also implemented a first aid drill to assist whoever gets burned. Keep ice packs in the freezer and plenty of bandages on hand if you're going to purchase this spawn of the devil and don't say I didn't warn you!!
